parsed.explanation: Parent regime creates serious traveler-facing border exposure: binary passport policy, refusal where documents cast doubt on sex, and possible fraud-based inadmissibility, plus national facility and immigration-custody harms. Those govern entry regardless of state. Within this state, documented mitigations are strong: no facility ban indicated, anti-discrimination law covering public places and services since 2011, gender-identity hate-crime coverage, X options on state IDs, custody housing and searches consistent with gender identity, and a 2022 care shield law. No trans-specific criminalisation is documented and courts remain a route, but the national border and custody exposures prevent a higher score.
